about.title: Blue Coral Landing 4 Bedroom 4 Bath With Dock, Guana Cay, Abaco, Bahamas.
about.text: Blue Coral Landing is a four-bedroom, four-bathroom waterfront cottage with a dock on the Sea of Abaco, designed for relaxed luxury and unforgettable island stays. The villa features a new sunroom, a master dining room with wet bar, and a tower bedroom with sweeping views over the Sea of Abaco. Sleeps up to 8 guests and is located directly on the water, just a short walk to the Atlantic Ocean and close to restaurants, shops, and the famous Nippers.

faq.title: Everything you need to know before you arrive.
faq.text: We want your stay to feel effortless, so these are the most common questions guests ask before booking.

items.question: How many guests can the cottage accommodate?
items.answer: Blue Coral Landing sleeps up to 8 guests across four bedrooms and four full bathrooms.

items.question: Is the dock suitable for boats?
items.answer: Yes, guests can dock their own boat and enjoy direct waterfront access to the Sea of Abaco.

items.question: Is the property family-friendly?
items.answer: Absolutely. The home welcomes children and families while maintaining a peaceful luxury atmosphere.

items.question: How close is the property to the beach?
items.answer: The Atlantic beach is only a short 3-minute walk away.
